description: Changes: adds one stay at the hotel's own price, guarantee Pending; takes one room of its type off sale on the booking sites; the hotel's own confirmation letter follows when its booking follow-up is on. Previews first: the first call shows the change and makes nothing. Makes a reservation at the hotel's own price for those nights (the hotel's default desk plan unless rate_plan is sent). First call without confirm: a preview (each night's rate, the total, rooms left, the letter), nothing is booked. A full night, a closed date or another price is refused as for a desk clerk. Second step: after the preview, the call with confirm true sends a link to the person's own phone or e-mail; the change is made only when they open it and press Approve. Call again with the same values to learn whether it was made. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to go ahead with the change shown in the preview

rate_plan.description: Rate plan code (the hotel's default when not sent)
